# Nagi Servo patch boundary

This directory is the tracked Nagi-owned patch boundary for the pinned Servo
source. The Servo checkout at `third_party/servo/` is generated by `nagi fetch`
from the exact revision in `third_party/sources.lock` and is intentionally not
stored in the Nagi parent repository.

Nagi-specific Servo changes must be represented here as numbered, reproducible
patches or adapters. Do not edit the generated Servo checkout as a substitute
for recording a patch in this directory.

`nagi fetch` applies `*.patch` files in lexical filename order after checking
each patch with `git apply --check`. The generated checkout contains an ignored
`.nagi-servo-checkout` marker with the pinned revision, patch-set fingerprint,
and generated worktree fingerprint. A missing or mismatched marker, unrelated
dirty state, or an unexpected destination is a refusal, not an invitation to
overwrite the checkout.
